evals.prompt: Review the supplied draft PRD against the complete source bundle and assess whether it is ready for delivery planning.
evals.expected_output: The review inventories the mixed-format source atoms, identifies each omitted obligation, and blocks readiness until every atom is mapped or has a source-authorized disposition.
expectations: Treats the named prose clause, each table row, the email decision, and the mockup annotation as independently accountable source atoms
Finds that the draft lost the prose exception, one table-row obligation, the email decision, and the mockup annotation
Does not treat the executive summary or synthesized requirements list as disposition evidence
Preserves source locators, modality, conditions, exceptions, and values in the reconciliation
Reports the delivery-planning handoff as blocked until every omission is mapped or source-authorized as out of scope
